description: This file defines the MediaContentJob class, which extends JobService. It handles scheduled jobs that monitor changes in media content URIs, including scheduling, checking if scheduled, and handling job start and stop events.

classes.name: MediaContentJob
classes.description: A JobService subclass that monitors media content URI changes, schedules jobs, and reacts on job start and stop events.

methods.name: scheduleJob
methods.description: Schedules a job to monitor media content URI changes with the system's JobScheduler.

methods.name: isScheduled
methods.description: Checks if the media content monitoring job is currently scheduled.

methods.name: cancelJob
methods.description: Cancels the scheduled media content monitoring job.

methods.name: onStartJob
methods.description: Called when the job starts; displays a toast with information about media content changes and sets a delayed worker to simulate work.

methods.name: onStopJob
methods.description: Called when the job is stopped; removes pending callbacks.
